name: Woolgather
description: Woolgather is a boutique event and wedding planning studio specializing in thoughtfully curated celebrations across weddings, social events, and corporate experiences. We work closely with each client to understand their vision, style, and story, translating it into a seamless and beautifully executed event. From concept development and design to vendor coordination and on-ground execution, our team ensures every detail is handled with precision and care. Known for our creative direction, transparent planning, and hands-on approach, we deliver experiences that feel effortless yet unforgettable. Whether it’s an intimate gathering or a large-scale celebration, Woolgather brings your daydreams to life with elegance and intent.

featured_reviews.name: Dhaval Mandan
featured_reviews.review_text:
An absolutely phenomenal and unforgettable experience with this event management company! Their professionalism, creativity, dedication, and flawless execution truly exceeded all expectations. From the initial planning to the final moment of the event, every single detail was handled with perfection, elegance, and exceptional coordination.
The team was incredibly supportive, innovative, punctual, and highly attentive, ensuring a completely stress-free and luxurious experience. The décor was breathtaking, the arrangements were world-class, and the overall atmosphere they created was simply magical and mesmerizing. Every guest was deeply impressed by the smooth management and outstanding hospitality.
Their passion, commitment to excellence, and ability to turn ideas into reality make them one of the best event management companies out there. Highly recommended for anyone looking to create a spectacular, memorable, and grand celebration!

featured_reviews.name: ridhi jain
featured_reviews.review_text:

Thankyou for making the event so special and unforgettable ❤️✨

featured_reviews.name: Nevy Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a team that plans weddings, social, or corporate events with heart, creativity, and complete attention to detail, they are truly the best people to trust. Every event feels thoughtfully curated and beautifully executed with the most genuine and hardworking team behind it.

What makes them stand out is their honesty, out-of-the-box ideas and the warmth with which they work — they genuinely make you feel like family throughout the process. Highly recommend them for anyone who wants their special moments handled with care, passion, and perfection. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Paridhi Madhani
featured_reviews.review_text: They are very creative, professional and so easy to work with! Love their work. They made our event absolutely unforgettable and our guests had the best time.

featured_reviews.name: Nikki Panani
featured_reviews.review_text: “Absolutely love their work! Woolgather creates the most beautiful and thoughtfully curated wedding experiences. Every detail feels elegant, unique, and perfectly executed. Their team is creative, professional, and so easy to work with — they truly make the entire process smooth and memorable.”

featured_reviews.name: Hussain Masalawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been working with this team for a long time now, and honestly, calling them event planners would be an understatement, they’re superhumans!  :)
Handling multiple things at once, managing every tiny detail, solving last minute chaos like it’s nothing… and still pulling off everything so smoothly is just unbelievable. A special mention to Kinjal & Shramik for building such an incredible team. Kinjal’s creativity and attention to detail are unmatched, she genuinely listens to every little requirement and makes sure it all comes to life beautifully. If I start writing about all my experiences with them, Google’s character limit would fall short. In short, if you want your event done right, stress free, and beautifully managed, this is the team. Once you work with them, you won’t look for another planner again.

featured_reviews.name: Priyank Harsora
featured_reviews.review_text: The best part wasn’t just the decoration, it was how calmly and professionally the team handled everything behind the scenes. Guests enjoyed, and we didn’t have to worry about a single thing.

featured_reviews.name: Liza Alva Pandya
featured_reviews.review_text: In events, finding someone dependable makes all the difference, and Kinjal Shah from Woolgather is exactly that. Always just a call away, prompt in communication, and committed to delivering great service. If you're planning your big day, she’s someone you can confidently hand things over to—eyes closed.

For so many things we went with their recommendation and honestly that was the best decision. They both know what they are doing and always recommend the best options under the given circumstances.

During the actual wedding events, my wife and I had shadows provided by Panaash who did such an awesome job of taking care of our every need. Shout out to Mayur Surve who really went beyond in helping me with everything.
Even the guests were praising how awesome the event was organized and the hospitality of the Panaash team.
I am so thankful to their team for making our wedding such a memorable and joyful event for not just us but all our guests.

Panaash Entertainment has an incredible team. Every time, Yash showed up on a one call or message. Even when I and my fiancée were busy, Yash always made an effort to talk to us. He is totally professional and polite person. His works is highly admirable. He provides "SHADOW as the person" to the Groom-Bride, and the Bride and Groom's parents. The nicest part about that is that "The Shadow" was always by our side and gave us a lot of support & help. His team is excellent. For destination weddings, I heartily recommend Pannash Entertainment.
Thank you Yash & Pannash Team for making our wedding Memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Ria Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really really late to post it but definitely had to do it.

Even after a year of our marriage everyone still says what a grand marriage it was. The duo Yash and Mayur and ofcourse their super cool team made this possible.

Very very fortunate enough to meet them and have the most important day of our lives planned by them.

They will definitely go above and beyond your expectations. You ask for it and they have you all covered up. The shadows aligned to us were master stroke calming our nerves and handling everything around.  All our guests were super happy with minute detailing and personal touch they provided to each and everyone.

I would just say they are just class apart. Cheers Team Panache 💃🏻🧿

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text: Our wedding was so flawless because we had the best team of Mayur and Yash by our side. As newlyweds, my spouse and I cannot express enough gratitude and appreciation to Panaash Entertainment for making our dream wedding a reality. From the moment we engaged their services until the last dance of the night, Panaash demonstrated unparalleled professionalism, creativity, and attention to detail.  Right from our initial meeting, their team exuded warmth and enthusiasm. They took the time to understand our vision and expectations, and their suggestions and ideas were invaluable in enhancing the overall experience. Throughout the planning process, they were prompt and responsive to our questions, providing us with a sense of reassurance that everything was being handled with care.  Panaash Entertainment's organizational skills were truly commendable. They coordinated with vendors seamlessly, ensuring that every aspect of the event was executed flawlessly. From the stunning floral arrangements to the exquisite decor and lighting, our venue was transformed into a magical wonderland that left all our guests in awe.  One aspect that stood out was their ability to cater to both traditional and contemporary preferences. Our families come from diverse cultural backgrounds, and Panaash managed to strike the perfect balance, infusing elements from both our cultures to create a harmonious celebration that appealed to everyone.  On the day of the wedding, their team worked tirelessly behind the scenes, ensuring that everything unfolded smoothly. We were able to relax and enjoy the festivities, knowing that Panaash was taking care of every detail. They even managed unexpected challenges with grace and quick thinking, which further solidified our trust in their capabilities.  Not only did Panaash Entertainment excel in their planning skills, but their personable and attentive approach made them a joy to work with. They treated us like family and shared in our excitement, which created a genuine and heartfelt connection.  In conclusion, we wholeheartedly recommend Panaash Entertainment to anyone seeking a wedding planner who goes above and beyond to create a magical and unforgettable experience. Their expertise, creativity, and dedication truly set them apart, and we couldn't have asked for a more perfect wedding day. Thank you, Panaash, for making our dreams come true!

featured_reviews.name: akshit kampani
featured_reviews.review_text:
For sure, without giving any 2nd thought, I will recommend Panaash Entertainment to my friends and family. My sister got married recently and we hired Panaash Entertainment as wedding planner. Firstly, I thought why we should do that as we never hired any wedding planner in the past. But, this time we hired the wedding planning agency and I think, this was the best decision we made. Yash and Mayur was fantastic, corporative and made all the arrangements of wedding easy. I came just 3 weeks before marriage from Canada and was around the place to see what arrangements are completed and what is left. After reaching Mumbai for wedding I met whole Panaash Entertainment team and everyone was fantastic and awesome and made this wedding successful. Being bride brother, had so many responsibilities - Handling Hotel arrangements, attending relatives, coordinating with everyone etc but these guys made my life easy and was able to enjoy the wedding to the fullest.
We had 3 functions in 1 day, and have to decorate the same room 3 times. These guys made it possible and that too on time.
Special mention to Pooja for taking care of Room reservations and arrangements for all the family members.
Thank you again for making this marriage a grand success.😍😘😃

featured_reviews.name: Jinal shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience with Panaash Entertainment for my brother’s wedding. The decor, planning, and coordination were beautifully managed. Everything was organized perfectly and the team made the entire event smooth and memorable for our family. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Bagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dadi always said, ‘ghar pahave bandhun ani lagna pahave karun’, translated it means, experience the joy and efforts in building a house and marrying.
Wedding is the most important day, definitely, but it is finale of 1000 different things planned in the backend to all work in sync to perfection on the day to make it happen.
These 1000 things, fortunately for us, was just 1 - Panaash Entertainment. Our wedding planner. Everything delivered, all demands, realistic or unrealistic, fulfilled, all activities planned, conceptualised and executed to perfection with a smile that never goes away.

From pre-wedding photoshoot where the team worked tirelessly continuously for hours and won us over to the 2 wedding days and the receptions that followed, we just had to call Panaash and we knew the task is done. Managing this entire thing between 2 cities and a pandemic, Yash and Mayur made sure that these 2 days became the most memorable 2 days because we didn’t have to worry about anything but our expressions in the photos!!!!

Yash with his trademark, ‘haan ho jaega’ and Mayur with his, ‘aare aap tension kyu le rahe ho, hum dekh lenge’, deliver what they promise - if you know me, you know it will be done.

Trust Yash and Mayur to only make your big day even better and more memorable. Knowing them for managing our wedding as well as my Brother-in-law’s within a span of 2 months, highly recommend this duo, with their tireless team! Thanks a lot Yash, Mayur and the entire team at Panaash! You guys rock :)

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Nayyar
featured_reviews.review_text: Yash and Mayur are fantastic people to work with - we would definitely recommend Panaash! You wouldn’t even know till the last second but Yash and Mayur have already thought two steps ahead and done the work that you would be stressing about! Both the team and Yash and Mayur are fun people and will always be around you to make sure no one from the family is worked up and enjoying the function to the fullest. Young team full of energy and ideas. Great working with you guys.

The staff was extremely friendly, professional, and always ready to help. Their hospitality made us feel welcome throughout our stay. The swimming pool was clean and well-maintained, providing a perfect place to relax and enjoy time with family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: Sarita Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this resort recently for an overnight family stay, and unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing — especially considering we were travelling with senior citizens, a diabetic family member, and young children.
I’ll start with the positives:
The location is convenient and very close to the market.
The pool remains open till 10 PM.
They have DJ music at night which some guests may enjoy.
Rooms were decent and manageable for a short stay.
However, the negatives completely overshadowed the positives.
The aur condition in the room had a leakage.
POOL HYGIENE & CLEANLINESS: The swimming pool appeared clean in the morning, but by evening it had turned extremely dirty and milky. Guests were eating food right beside the pool, kids were jumping into the water while eating, beer bottles and cups were lying around, and there seemed to be no strict hygiene rules followed. Even after complaining, the staff simply said they would “switch on the filter motor” as they could not do much about it.
The problem is not just filtering — the pool maintenance system itself appears poor because the dirty water does not drain out properly for fresh water circulation. Several guests were openly complaining about dirty water, bottles, and cups floating around.

HYGIENE AROUND THE PROPERTY: The tables near the pool had ants crawling all over them. Chairs had dried food stains and were clearly not cleaned properly. Overall cleanliness and upkeep were below average.
FOOD & SERVICE ISSUES: The food was average at best. The chicken koliwada was excessively salty. Buffet items would frequently finish, and refilling took nearly 10 minutes each time, leaving guests waiting repeatedly.
What was even more concerning was the lack of hygiene during food service. Guests were picking papad and chapatis directly with their hands instead of using the provided tongs/spoons, and the serving staff sitting there did absolutely nothing to stop it.
HIGH TEA & DIABETIC CONCERNS: One of the biggest disappointments was the high tea service. Tea and coffee already had sugar pre-added with no sugar-free option available. No black tea, plain tea, or black coffee was included in the package. We were told to purchase those separately from the à la carte menu.
This is extremely careless when guests may include diabetics or senior citizens. A basic sugar-free option should be mandatory in any hospitality service. We were not upset about paying extra — the issue was that despite already paying for the package, basic beverage variants were not included.
FOOD SAFETY CONCERN: The next morning before checkout, my daughter ate a sliced bread provided there and shortly after developed vomiting and fever symptoms, which genuinely raised concerns about food hygiene and storage.
BILLING ISSUES: This was another major red flag. Their billing system is extremely unorganized and feels unreliable.
We had carried our own pack of 12 water bottles from home and only purchased ONE bottle from the resort. Yet during checkout, they added FIVE bottles to our bill.
Similarly:
We had only taken 2 black coffees on credit, but they added 5.
Cold drink quantities were also inflated.
Only after clarifying did they reduce the charges correctly.
The shocking part was that another family at checkout was also arguing over inflated billing — especially overcharged water bottles. This clearly indicates a recurring issue and not a one-time mistake.
FINAL VERDICT: If you are travelling with family, kids, elderly people, or anyone with medical concerns, I genuinely would not recommend this property. The lack of hygiene, careless service, poor pool maintenance, and questionable billing practices completely ruined the experience for us.

featured_reviews.name: Oswin Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
Genuine review - We visited Starwoods Resort on 5th May 2026 for a corporate outing, and unfortunately, our experience was disappointing.

The rooms had an unpleasant smell, and even the towels appeared inadequately washed and carried an odor. We had suggested serving vada pav, but what was served tasted more like kanda bhaji. The swimming pool was not well-maintained and felt dirty. Additionally, due to the extreme summer heat, the pool water and overall resort premises were uncomfortably hot.

One of the most disappointing incidents occurred around midnight when I requested drinking water from a staff member at the reception. While he was casually scrolling through his phone, his response was, “12 baj gaye aur reception bandh hai toh paani nahi, aur baaki kuch nahi milega. After insisting he gave us!!! At the very least, water bottles should be made available to guests even in the rooms especially considering the weather conditions. We expected better hospitality and guest service.

The following day, there were random guests occupying the poolside area despite our booking being scheduled until 4 PM.

On a positive note, the vegetarian options during lunch, dinner, and breakfast were quite good. However, the gulab jamun lacked flavor and was not up to expectations.

My suggestion to anyone considering this venue is to personally inspect the property before confirming a booking. Unfortunately, we did not do so and ended up regretting our decision.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic Service!!! Let me jot down the points.
1- Upon booking we were told DJ music will be played from 1200-1000 but to our surprise there wasn’t DJ at all and 2 common speaker was given to 3 groups.
2- Shockingly at 5pm we saw around 15 kids who has come to learn swimming in the same pool. Upon asking the Manager Gautam had no clue and asked to speak to his senior Nirmal.. And the senior Guy Nirmal says its common. Have been to many places and haven’t seen such swimming classes going on in a resort swimming pool.
4- Only filter or rain dance only 1 equip they can run at a time, Again a shock to us.
3- Rooms are very small and our room Ac was very slow to cool down. Although to change room option was given but we did not opt.

So who ever is planning to visit this resort be prepared to all this last min surprises.
Not visiting this resort any time in this life..

The décor was thoughtfully done and perfectly complemented the openness of the venue. From the tasteful lighting to the well-placed floral arrangements, everything came together beautifully without feeling overdone. A huge shoutout to the host, Bhavesh, for the incredible effort put into everything, from the venue and décor to the wonderful hospitality.
